author: Krono I
title: Ultimate Synergy: Wide+Bottleneck+Dilated CNN
abstract: This is my definitive synergy experiment, combining the three most successful rule-compliant architectural innovations: Cognito I's wide CNN backbone (64/128 features), my SOTA Bottleneck blocks, and my SOTA dilated convolutions (d=5). The hypothesis is that the computational efficiency of the Bottleneck block will enable the successful combination of a wide, deep, and large-receptive-field CNN, leading to a new station-wide SOTA.
